claims.note: The reference describes a battery gripper for a tube lifter, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device with a suction plate.

claims.quote: Battery gripper ( 12 ), for attracting by suction and handling starter batteries ( 26 ) of, in particular, motor vehicles, having a housing ( 56 ), in which a vacuum chamber which can be loaded with vacuum is provided
claims.note: The reference discloses a housing with a vacuum chamber for suction, but it does not specify an electrically operated vacuum generating device within the housing, nor a grip portion as described in the claim context.
The reference describes a pistol grip as part of an operating device, but does not state that the grip portion of the battery gripper itself is designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air from a vacuum generating device being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor a sound-damping device in the grip portion.
This reference does not disclose a sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion.
This reference does not disclose a grip portion at least partially lined with a sound-damping material.
This reference does not disclose a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion of the housing.
This reference does not disclose a sound-reducing device arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion being lined with sound-reducing material.

The reference describes a battery gripper with a T-shaped cross-section and suction openings, but does not mention a grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.

The reference describes a battery gripper that uses vacuum for suction but does not mention an air collection device, an air collection screw, or the collection of exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.
The reference describes a battery gripper with a vacuum chamber and suction openings, but does not mention air baffles for guiding exhaust air downstream of a grip portion.

The reference describes a battery gripper for handling starter batteries and mentions a coupling section for connection to a tube lifter, but does not describe a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on the housing, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.
The reference describes a battery gripper with a vacuum system but does not mention air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

claims.quote: The invention relates to a battery gripper for picking up by suction and handling starter batteries, in particular for picking up by suction and handling starter batteries of motor vehicles.
claims.note: The reference describes a battery gripper that picks up items by suction, which is a type of vacuum handling apparatus.
claims.refuted: The quote describes what the invention relates to (a battery gripper for picking up by suction), but does not explicitly state 'A vacuum handling apparatus comprising'.

claims.quote: A flexible lining in the form of a foam layer 82 is arranged on the suction side 54 and contacts the starter battery 26 .
claims.note: The reference discloses a flexible lining (seal) on the suction side, but it does not explicitly state that it is fastened to a carrier plate or extends around the carrier plate.

claims.quote: The invention relates to a battery gripper for picking up by suction and handling starter batteries, in particular for picking up by suction and handling starter batteries of motor vehicles.
claims.note: The reference describes a battery gripper, which is a type of grip unit.
claims.refuted: The quote describes the invention as a 'battery gripper' but does not refer to it as 'said grip unit according to claim 1' or define what 'claim 1' is.

claims.quote: Providing a coupling section of this kind makes it possible to connect the battery gripper to a tube lifter or to an operating device for a tube lifter.
claims.note: The reference describes a coupling section that allows the battery gripper (suction plate) to be connected to an operating device (grip unit) in a releasable manner.
claims.refuted: The quote discusses a coupling section for connecting the battery gripper to a tube lifter or operating device, which is different from the grip unit and suction plate being releasably connected to one another via a coupling device.

claims.quote: By means of the centering stud 34, a vacuum chamber (not shown in the figures) of the battery gripper 12 can be provided with a vacuum supply.
claims.note: The reference describes a centering stud that supplies vacuum to the vacuum chamber of the battery gripper, which is the suction plate.
claims.refuted: The quote mentions a centering stud providing a vacuum chamber with a vacuum supply, but it does not describe a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate to generate a vacuum between the suction plate and an object to be lifted.

overall.why: The reference describes a battery gripper with a suction plate and a grip unit that are releasably connected and share a vacuum supply, which aligns with some core aspects of the subject invention.
